EN.title: YOUR FIRST 5 MINUTES
steps: EDIT SHIP to build, or BLUEPRINTS to load a saved ship. Cards show COST.
Fit a core, power, thrusters and weapons. Connect the hull; keep exhausts and launch paths clear. Direct guns face the core's nose.
SAVE, then use TEST FLIGHT first. For a mission: PLAY, choose ship/difficulty, stay within budget, then START.
buildkeys: Copy a module to your hand
Mirror about the core; both sides must fit
EN.grouptext: In WEAPON GROUPS, drag a weapon to a group and release to assign it. A group click only shows its members. New/default groups: 1 = direct guns / left mouse, 2 = missiles / right mouse. Saved ships may use different bindings.
EN.practice: TRAINING RANGE: SELECT TARGET, set ATTACK and MOVE, then ENTER. Try movement and weapons here before deploying.
flykeys: Deploy a fitted, ready flare launcher
EN.steering: Mouse offset is a continuous turn command. Bring it back toward the centre to ease the turn. Releasing movement keys engages automatic braking.
EN.goaltext: Defeat all 6 waves and remaining enemies. The final wave brings the t8 flagship + escorts. Your core being destroyed ends the sortie. Repair the design and redeploy.
hudrows: RED TARGETS
Radar contacts; F selects your main target.
SHIELD
Absorbs hits. It recovers using energy.
ENERGY
Powers propulsion, weapons and shield recovery.
WEAPON CELLS
Bright = ready. Dim / a number = unavailable or reloading.
HEAT
Gatling orange heat rises during fire. After overheating, cool to empty to fire again.
tips: Beams: aim at the ship. Projectile guns: use the red lead marker for moving targets. Slight assistance corrects mounting offset only.
Regular missiles: F-lock a target, wait for missile acquisition, then hold the missile group's fire button. Reloading missiles must acquire again.
VLS: keep radar-marked enemies in view for 4 seconds, then fire its group. It splits the magazine across targets; each unit reloads independently.
Low energy? Release boost and stop firing briefly. Shield recovery gets power first, then propulsion, then weapons. Boost raises the speed limit; releasing it restores the normal limit.
EN.footer: Default keys shown. Settings can rebind flight actions; weapon fire bindings belong to each blueprint.  |  ? / HELP explains the current screen.

ZH.title: 新手五分钟速查
ZH.sub: 拼装  >  靶场练习  >  正式出击
steps: 点 EDIT SHIP / 编辑飞船 开始拼装，或从 BLUEPRINTS / 蓝图库 载入。蓝图卡片的 COST 是造价。
装上核心、电源、推进器和武器，让舰体连成整体，炮口、喷口和发射区保持净空。直射武器朝向核心船头。
先 SAVE / 保存，再进 TEST FLIGHT / 试飞。正式关卡点 PLAY，选船与难度，确认不超预算后点 START。
buildkeys: 放置；X 切换删除模式
打开 / 关闭组件目录
按核心左右镜像；两侧都须能安装
打开 / 关闭武器组界面
旋转视角；按 Shift 拖动可平移
ZH.grouptext: 在武器组中把武器拖到组框，松手即完成分配。之后点击组框只查看成员。新建默认组：1 组直射武器 / 左键，2 组导弹 / 右键。旧蓝图可能保存了其他开火键。
ZH.practice: 靶场：点 SELECT TARGET 选靶机，设置 ATTACK（是否攻击）和 MOVE（是否移动），再点 ENTER 进入。先熟悉操作。
flykeys: 发射绑定到该键的武器组
锁定 / 解除前方目标
释放已安装且就绪的干扰弹
启用 / 关闭对应武器组
切换直射弹道武器齐射 / 交替
镜头距离 / 暂停与选项
ZH.steering: 鼠标偏移是持续转向指令，移回中央才会减小转向。松开移动键会自动制动；转向速度受舰船机动性限制。
ZH.goaltext: 消灭全部六波及剩余敌人。最后一波是 t8 旗舰和护卫舰队。自己的核心被摧毁则本次出击失败；返回修改蓝图后重新出击。
hudrows: 红色目标
雷达发现的敌人；F 选择主锁定目标。
护盾
抵挡伤害；恢复时消耗电力。
能量
供推进、武器和护盾恢复使用。
武器格
亮色为就绪；暗色或数字表示暂不可用 / 冷却。
热量
机枪橙色热量上升；过热后必须冷却到底。
tips: 光束瞄准敌舰；弹道武器攻击移动目标时参考红色预瞄点。轻微辅助只补偿炮口位置偏差。
常规导弹：按 F 锁定敌人，等导弹完成锁定，再按住导弹组开火键。装填完成后还要重新锁定。
垂发导弹：让有雷达标记的敌人留在视野内四秒，再按该组开火键；弹药会分给多个目标，各组件独立装填。
没电了？松开加力并暂停开火。供电优先护盾恢复，其次推进，最后武器。加力可临时提高限速，松开后会回落。
ZH.footer: 本页为默认键位；飞行动作可在设置改键，武器组开火键随蓝图保存。  |  ? / 帮助可查看当前界面的说明。
